# -- tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_grant_reward_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_grant_reward_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_charter_options_favorable_count }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_public_credit_pledges_favorable_count }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable >= 7 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 5 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable >= 4 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 3 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_reward_modifier_lesser years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable
	tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_charter_options_cleanup_write_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_public_credit_pledges_cleanup_write_effect = yes
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_row_set_index
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_completed value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}

# -- tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_monthly_progress_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_active_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_row_set_index ?= 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1670 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1671 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_charter_options_has_contested_entity_trigger = yes }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1672 days = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1673 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 3 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_row_set_index add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_row_set_index ?= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1674 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1675 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_public_credit_pledges_has_contested_entity_trigger = yes }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1676 days = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1677 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase ?= 3 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_row_set_index add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# -- tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_start_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_start_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_row_set_index value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_phase value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event
}
